title: Typing in a search field only types
steps: Open All mail (G A), select a conversation, press /, and type eerjk# and some words; do the same in Inbox and a label
With two accounts, open All Inboxes, click its search field, type jessie e, and press Return
In the All Inboxes list, press J and then E
While a search field has the caret, switch Appearance between light and dark
expected: The letters appear in the field; no conversation is marked done, trashed, replied to or moved, and the selection stays. In All Inboxes, Return keeps All Inboxes open and moves the keys to the list, where J and E work again. The caret stays in the field across the appearance change.
